title: Native migration contracts and verified continuation
summary: Dev6/dev7 bridges check real Job-to-Node Allocator lease/lifecycle and Memory Fabric context objects, and Migratable Job 0.2.2 definitions, checkpoint and transfer records. These are read-only integrity/admissibility checks, not a reimplementation of migration.
invariants: Source ownership epoch and lease validity must bind to the exact job.
Fresh lifecycle evidence and matched destination/route/context are mandatory.
Checkpoint/transfer records may be locally consistent yet not cryptographically authenticated.
Migratable Job transfer byte count can lose integer exactness at default ooRexx precision; invoice-grade cost requires exact authoritative counters.
An observed success state must not be treated as a provider charge.

provenance.claim: Cloud Economics v0.1-dev8 source evidence; status=IMPLEMENTED.

procedure: Inspect native source placement and execution state.
Verify destination eligibility from issuing allocator and policy.
Verify workload identity, checkpoint/transfer source fencing and continuation record consistency.
Leave authority to checkpoint, handoff, transfer and resume entirely with Migratable Job.
